game.title: Los Angeles Chargers at Los Angeles Rams

lede: Los Angeles Rams carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#5 in EPA per play), while Los Angeles Chargers owns the more favourable defensive matchup (#4 in EPA allowed per play).
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Los Angeles Rams −5.0 with a fair total of 46.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Los Angeles Chargers pass offence vs Los Angeles Rams pass defence, which sits −0.133 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.

The largest uncertainty is quarterback information: Los Angeles Chargers and Los Angeles Rams have no confirmed starter on file, which materially affects how much confidence the exact number deserves.
